description: This PHP source file defines the class `CaseUpdatesHook`, implementing various hook methods for handling case updates, email notifications, file attachments, and status changes within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It interacts with the CRM's beans, email system, and related modules to automate case management tasks.

classes.name: CaseUpdatesHook
classes.description: Class implementing various hook methods for case update handling, including saving updates, sending notifications, managing case status, and managing email communications.

methods.name: getAssignToUser
methods.description: Retrieves the next user to assign a case to by utilizing the AOPAssignManager.

methods.name: arrangeFilesArray
methods.description: Rearranges the $_FILES array for multiple file uploads related to case updates, returns the count of files processed.

methods.name: saveUpdate
methods.description: Main method to save a case update, attach files, and handle related notifications and status changes.

methods.name: newNote
methods.description: Creates a new Note bean linked to a specific case update ID.

methods.name: linkAccountAndCase
methods.description: Links a case to an account if not already linked.

methods.name: assignAccount
methods.description: Assigns a case to an account based on related contact information when a case is related to a contact.

methods.name: saveEmailUpdate
methods.description: Creates a case update based on an email received, linking related notes and updating case status.

methods.name: updateCaseStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and state of a case based on configuration mappings.

methods.name: unquoteEmail
methods.description: Removes email reply delimiters and decodes HTML entities from email text.

methods.name: closureNotifyPrep
methods.description: Prepares notification flags for case closure email notifications.

methods.name: closureNotify
methods.description: Sends closure notification emails if the case has been closed and notification is enabled.

methods.name: sendClosureEmail
methods.description: Composes and sends the case closure email notification.

methods.name: creationNotify
methods.description: Sends notification emails when a new case is related to a contact.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Fills email template placeholders with case and contact data to generate email content.

methods.name: getAOPConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the AOP configuration array from global settings.

methods.name: sendCreationEmail
methods.description: Sends an email notification to a contact when a new case is created or assigned.

methods.name: logEmail
methods.description: Logs an email sent to a case in the Emails module.

methods.name: filterHTML
methods.description: Cleans HTML content of a case's description.

methods.name: sendCaseUpdate
methods.description: Sends email notifications about case updates based on configured templates and rules.
